titre: Primes encaissées et prestations versées dans le monde

Primes vie.texte: Gross written premiums in the life sector grew by 11.5% in nominal terms and 7.0% in real terms in 2025

Prestations vie.texte: claims payments slowed from 8.2% in nominal terms and 5.2% in real terms in 2024, to 4.5% and 0.1% respectively

Primes dommages.texte: Gross premiums written in the non-life sector rose by 8.5% in nominal terms and 4.2% in real terms in 2025

Sinistres dommages.texte: Claims payments also grew by 9.1% in nominal terms and 4.8% in real terms
